_readme: Template only. Copy to tracking3d.json in this folder, fill it in and delete the '_example' line; the main_*.py scripts refuse to run a config that still has it. Shared: other configs pull it in with "_include", so it is set once. Used by steps 7 to 9.

tracking3d._readme: Pixel values are in undistorted pixels; distances in world units (cameras t x t_scale). conf_threshold null = every saved prediction. min_track_extent drops tracks that barely move (static false positives). n_tracks null = keep every track that passes min_track_frames, else keep the n with the most supporting detections. static_radius_px / static_min_fraction: before tracking, predicted detections at a spot (within static_radius_px) the detector fires on in at least static_min_fraction of a view's frames are removed as background clutter; static_min_fraction null = keep them. Keep the fraction above the share of the video a fly can sit still for.
tracking3d._evaluation_readme: main_tracks3d.py / main_tracks3d_guided.py write each run to <run>/3d/<model>/factor_graph/<tracks|guided>_<datetime>/ and, when the run has ground-truth labels, evaluate the tracks. eval_match_distance = how close (world units) a track point must be to a ground-truth 3D point to count as a match (evaluation_3d.txt). evaluate_2d = recompute the 2D metrics with the tracks projected back into each camera, a box inserted wherever a track has no detection (evaluation_2d.txt); backproj_score = the confidence given to those boxes (keep it >= the model confidence threshold, or they only count towards AP). visualise_backproj_graph = redo the 2D track plots with the inserted boxes drawn in orange (track_plots_backproj/). visualise_backproj_video = one video per camera in reprojection/<camera>.mp4: detector boxes in blue, ground truth in green, every track's reprojected position as a red dot in every frame (also on top of detector boxes, to show how well the track follows them), inserted boxes in red (H.264 through ffmpeg if installed, else larger mp4v files). With either of the two, the inserted boxes are also saved as YOLO labels like the run's predictions: reprojection/labels/<input>/<sequence>/<frame>.txt (class xc yc w h score) plus data.yaml.
tracking3d._guided_readme: main_tracks3d_guided.py only. anchor_pixel_sigma = trust in a hand-placed start/end point (px). A start / end is seeded by the unguided track (else tracklet) passing within anchor_gate_px of its annotation, or starting / ending up to anchor_frame_window frames away, allowing anchor_max_px_per_frame of movement per frame in between. guided_iterations = association / optimisation rounds per object.
